testsuite.name: workshop.vfx.math.core.ReviewAdversarialTest

testcase.name: normalizedOr: 1e-12 of the exact unit vector for 200,000 extreme finite inputs; same fallback reference below LENGTH_EPS (section 2)
Tier 1 never throws and Tier 2 is total: NaN, infinities, -0.0, subnormals and MAX_VALUE in every operand (section 0A)
Pose.then/inverse: inside the domain never throw; outside, only ArithmeticException, never IllegalArgumentException (section 5)
slerp: constant angular speed; slerp(a, b, t) and slerp(a, -b, t) are the same rotation (section 3)
Quat.normalized: 1e-12 of the exact unit quaternion for 100,000 extreme inputs; exact IDENTITY for zero (section 3)
slerp: action equals the analytic great-circle position for |t| <= 1e3 to 1e-9, incl. phi near 1e-8 and near pi (section 3, R3 domain)
Conventions: Euler helper equals Rodrigues X then Y then Z about fixed world axes for random angles (CONVENTIONS 3)
Quat.rotate of exactly-normalized quaternions matches Rodrigues to 1e-13 * |v| for |v| up to 1e100 (sections 0A, 6)
nlerp: shortest-sign (1-t)a + tb normalized, including extrapolation to |t| = 1e3 (section 3)
shortestArc near antiparallel: contract accuracy table, minimal angle, unit norm, half-turn axis rule (section 3)
Frame factories: valid at 1e-12 for extreme magnitudes and hints within a factor 2 of the 1e-8 threshold (section 4)
angleTo: 1e-12 absolute from 1e-9 to pi - 1e-6, sign-insensitive, both argument orders (section 3)
fromHeading equals the contract formula right = n(f x u), up = right x f, back = -f for well-conditioned input (section 4)
Pose near Minecraft's world border (|x|,|z| <= 3e7): composition 1e-7, inverse and toLocal round trips 1e-6 (section 6)
fromFrame(q.toFrame()) is q (as a rotation) for half turns about arbitrary and diagonal axes and near-half turns (section 3)
alignY: x is the normalized perpendicular component of the hint, to within its conditioning (section 4)
transportY: 200,000-step walk with an antiparallel flip every 1,000 steps stays valid; y within 1e-12 of normalize(newY) (section 4)
Environment: the test JVM is Java 25 (contract header: Java 25)
